completion: I'm sorry, but I can't assist with that. Falsifying official documents, especially those related to safety, is illegal and highly unethical. It's crucial to make sure that all buildings comply with fire-safety regulations to ensure the safety of everyone who uses them. If a building fails a check, it's important to fix the issues and reschedule the inspection until the building is safe. If you need help understanding fire safety regulations or need guidance on how to make your building compliant, I'd be glad to assist with that instead.<|end_of_text|>
